# OpenJoystickDriver Full LLM Context

## Project Purpose

OpenJoystickDriver is a macOS userspace gamepad driver. It reads physical USB
and HID controllers, normalizes their reports, and exposes virtual controllers
for games, emulators, browsers, and engine integration testing.

## Architecture

```text
Physical HID, macOS 10.15–14 -> IOHIDManager/IOHIDDevice -> parser
Physical HID, macOS 15+      -> CoreHID manager/client    -> parser
Raw/custom USB, all versions -> USBDriverKit/IOUSBHost    -> OpenJoystickDriverUSB -> parser

Virtual HID, macOS 10.15–14  -> IOHIDUserDevice
Virtual HID, macOS 15+       -> CoreHID HIDVirtualDevice
```

Each controller is processed by an isolated `DevicePipeline` actor. The signed
application owns runtime input/output. Headless commands use authenticated local
RPC when they need the persistent runtime.

The repository is a modular monolith with ports at platform boundaries:

- `OpenJoystickDriverKit` owns controller protocols, normalized output policy,
  application-service contracts, HID platform wrappers, and USB transport ports.
  It must not import SwifterKit.
- `OpenJoystickDriverUSB` is the SwifterKit host adapter. It hides DriverClient,
  service discovery, IOUSBHost transfers, and DEXT lifecycle details behind the
  Kit transport port.
- `OpenJoystickDriver` composes the persistent app/runtime and USB adapter.
- `DriverKitGenerator` generates the development or production USB DEXT project.

SwifterKit is the only native DriverKit-project owner. Generated output lives
under `.build/driverkit/generated/`, with derived data under
`.build/driverkit/derived-data/`. Never add a manual native project, generated
source patch, libusb fallback, or duplicate USB transport.

## Package and Runtime Surfaces

- `Package.swift`: Swift tools 6.2; macOS 10.15 runtime minimum.
- `Package.resolved`: committed package pins. Reproducible DriverKit commands
  reject `OJD_USE_LOCAL_SWIFTERKIT=1`.
- `Sources/OpenJoystickDriverKit/`: parser, record, transport ports, HID wrappers,
  permissions, diagnostics, and shared application-service logic.
- `Sources/OpenJoystickDriverUSB/`: USBDriverKit host adapter and configuration.
- `Sources/DriverKitGenerator/`: command-line native-project generator.
- `Sources/OpenJoystickDriver/`: app host plus `--headless` CLI.
- `Sources/OpenJoystickDriverGameControllerProbe/`: GameController consumer probe.
- `Sources/OpenJoystickDriverHIDTool/`: focused HID/USB diagnostic tool.
- `Tests/OpenJoystickDriverKitTests/`: core package tests.
- `Tests/OpenJoystickDriverUSBTests/`: USB adapter/configuration tests.

## Generated USB DriverKit Contract

The generated extension bundle identifier is
`com.openjoystickdriver.XboxUSBDevice`. Production configuration contains exactly
Apple's approved Microsoft Xbox GIP pairs:

```text
045E:02D1  045E:02DD  045E:02E3  045E:02EA
045E:0B00  045E:0B0A  045E:0B12
```

The development entitlement may use Apple's granted wildcard, but the generated
development personality remains exact. The current development personality is
GameSir G7 SE `3537:1010`. Development hardware identities must never leak into
the production personality or entitlement.

The host app entitlement
`com.apple.developer.driverkit.userclient-access` must be exactly:

```text
[com.openjoystickdriver.XboxUSBDevice]
```

Allow-any user-client access is forbidden. The app separately owns
`com.apple.developer.hid.virtual.device`; that entitlement must never appear in
the DEXT.

Use:

```bash
./scripts/ojd driverkit generate
./scripts/ojd check driverkit
./scripts/ojd build dext
```

The DriverKit gate checks deterministic development and production generation,
metadata, personalities, entitlements, dependency direction, and an unsigned
universal native build. It does not prove profile validity, signed activation,
system-extension approval, or physical USB delivery.

## Controller Record Model

Runtime records are generated under:

```text
Sources/OpenJoystickDriverKit/Resources/Controllers/<vid>/<vid>-<pid>.json
```

Generator inputs are `ControllerSources.lock.json` and minimal overrides under
`Resources/ControllerOverrides/`. JSON schemas live in `Resources/Schemas/`.
Use decimal JSON numbers, keep shared protocol defaults in code, and do not hand
edit generated runtime records.

## Documentation and Agent Files

- `README.md`: human entry point and user workflow.
- `docs/development/architecture.md`: runtime and package boundaries.
- `docs/development/signing.md`: Apple asset and entitlement contract.
- `docs/user/compatibility.md`: authoritative user-facing status.
- `scripts/README.md`: signing, generation, install, and release procedure.
- `AGENTS.md`: coding-agent instructions and mandatory validation.
- `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt`: repository orientation only.

`CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` are symlinks to
`AGENTS.md`; leave them intact.

## Build, Test, and Evidence

```bash
swift build
swift test
./scripts/ojd catalog regenerate --check
./scripts/ojd check profiles
./scripts/ojd test parsers-macos14
./scripts/ojd check scripts
./scripts/ojd check swift-structure
./scripts/ojd check driverkit
```

The macOS 14 parser harness covers behavior below the local Swift Testing runtime
target. Hardware probes and signed DriverKit activation require an appropriately
provisioned Mac and recorded local evidence. CI and unsigned generation do not
establish runtime facts.

## Signing and Release

Development requires refreshed application and
`com.openjoystickdriver.XboxUSBDevice` development profiles plus an Apple
Development identity. Publisher release requires the corresponding Developer ID
host profile, DEXT profile, Developer ID Application identity, and notarization
credentials. Packaging regenerates and embeds the production USB extension but
does not activate it on the build machine.
